authorization.basis: Explicit user authorization relayed by the coordinator after the terminal schemafix-run-01 custody failure.
authorization.scope: Prospective order-invariant response validation, a fresh held 36-cell registration, deterministic qualification, and independent review before any new provider call.

stopped_registration.disposition: One terminal non-result; no retry, replacement credit, score, or continuation through schemafix-run-02..schemafix-run-36.

defect.runtime_contract: The registered response schema accepts four closed consequence objects in any array order.
defect.prompt_contract: The participant task requires every listed consequence but prescribes no array order.
defect.custody_contract: The prior validator required claim IDs in alphabetically sorted order and rejected an otherwise schema-valid packet-order response.

fresh_identity_requirements.reason: The stopped registration consumed one assigned cell and exposed one participant response; it cannot be resumed or credited.

neutral_calibration.reason: The prior neutral calibration binds the stopped registration and prior benchmark/custody bytes; a new non-scientific calibration must bind the fresh registration after independent review.
